📖 Explanation:

The 1982 Formula One World Championship remains the most unpredictable season in F1 history, featuring a record-setting 11 different race winners across just 16 Grands Prix.

The eleven winners were Prost, Lauda, Pironi, Watson, Patrese, Piquet, Tambay, de Angelis, Rosberg, Arnoux, and Alboreto. Amazingly, no single driver managed to win more than two races over the course of the season.

Despite this massive dispersion of victories, Williams driver Keke Rosberg secured the Drivers' Championship while taking only a single race victory (the Swiss Grand Prix at Dijon-Prenois).
